evidence.detail: next_tournament_name and next_tournament_time are initialized to None on every View
setup_tournaments() sets those fields from tournaments.next_tournament_info()
setup_tournaments() is called on the home page
setup_tournaments() is also called on the tournaments page
shows 'X is in Y' but only included on home and tournaments pages, not in site-wide banner/layout
site-wide banner template has no tournament countdown; it's not present on every page

triage.fix_sketch: The countdown data (next_tournament_name, next_tournament_time) is already computed and shown on the home page and tournaments page via decksite/templates/tournamentcalendar.mustache. To add it site-wide, call setup_tournaments() in decksite/view.py's prepare() method (or in before_request) and include {{> tournamentcalendar}} in a base layout template such as banner.mustache or a new shared partial. The data fetch in tournaments.next_tournament_info() would then run on every request.
triage.notes: The feature is partially done (home + tournaments pages). Whether to add it to the global layout or a status bar is the remaining product/implementation decision. The data pipeline already exists.
